info.name: MediGuard - Complete API Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for MediGuard backend with automated token management and SRE response architecture validation.

**Features:**
- Automatic token storage and refresh
- SRE response wrapper validation
- All Djoser JWT endpoints
- Custom login endpoint
- User registration and management
- Health templates and records management
- Medicine management with scheduling
- Alarm system (derived from medicines)

**Setup:**
1. Import this collection
2. Set the `base_url` variable (default: http://localhost:8000)
3. Register a user or login to get started
4. Tokens are automatically managed and sent with all authenticated requests

**Apps Covered:**
- Authentication & User Management
- Health State (Templates & Records)
- Medicines (CRUD with scheduling)
- Alarms (Read-only, derived from medicines)

**Response Format:**
All responses follow SRE architecture:
```json
{
  "success": true/false,
  "response": { ...data },
  "error": null/{ "message": "...", "details": {...} }
}
```
